description:
Create a model key

Creates a model key for the account itself. The `secret` is returned once, in this response; a replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns the key with `secret: null`. Customer keys are created under /customers/{id}/keys. `maxPrice` gives it a default limit order (the most its requests are billed per 1M tokens), `minDiscount` a default minimum discount (its requests are served only at least that many percent under a model's list price), `speed` a default speed (how its requests pick among routes: cheapest, balanced, fastest or a custom floor and ceiling; see /docs/speed), and `ioRatio` its expected input:output ratio (15 or "15:1": routes are ranked at the prompt divided by it instead of at max_tokens; see /docs/speed#io-ratio). At most 500 model keys per account, and 1,000 new ones a day (revoked ones count): past either, 409 limit_reached.

allowedModels.description: Limit the key to these model ids; null or empty for all.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique string so that repeating this call never creates twice.

ioRatio.description: The key's expected input:output ratio (see Key.ioRatio), as a number of input tokens per output token or a string such as "15:1"; null or left out for none.

maxPrice.description: The key's default limit order (see Key.maxPrice); null or left out for none.

oneOf.description: A limit order's maximum price: the most a request is billed per 1M tokens, on the input leg, the output leg, the cache leg or several (at least one), each compared on its own. Send {"input", "output", "cache"}; the compatible names prompt, completion and input_cache_read (also cache_read) are the same legs and are accepted too, but a leg given under two names with different values is a 400. It is stored and returned under the compatible names (prompt, completion, input_cache_read). A request nothing in the market is within is refused with 422 no_offer_under_limit and billed nothing; a request with no limit is matched at the market price.

cache.description: USD per 1M input tokens read from the cache. A route that bills cached tokens at its input price is compared at that price.

cache_read.description: Another name for cache, accepted on input.

completion.description: The compatible name for output; returned under this name.

input_cache_read.description: The compatible name for cache; returned under this name.

prompt.description: The compatible name for input; returned under this name.

minDiscount.description: The key's default minimum discount, 0 to 100 (see Key.minDiscount); null or left out for none.

monthlyLimitUsd.description: Spend cap per calendar month; null or 0 for none.

priceFallover.description: The key's price fall-over (see Key.priceFallover); null or left out for the default (on).

speed.description: The key's default speed (see Key.speed); null or left out for none.

oneOf.description: How requests pick among the routes that can serve a model. `sort` orders the routes: `price` (cheapest first, the default), `throughput` (fastest tokens per second first; the :nitro suffix) or `latency` (quickest to the first token first). `minThroughput` and `maxLatencySecs` are best effort: routes that meet them come first, and when none does the request is still served by the next best route. A request that sets allow_fallbacks to false makes them strict instead (503 no_route_meets_speed). Community-supplied routes must also reach at least half the model's median speed to get traffic. Balanced is {sort: price, minThroughput: 30}; Fastest is {sort: throughput}. max_price still caps the price.

maxLatencySecs.description: Seconds to the first token a route should stay within; null for no ceiling.

minThroughput.description: Tokens per second a route should reach; null for no floor.

sort.description: What the routes are ordered by.
